Wings outstretched, chilling wind flowing across orange feathers holding aloft the little round male bird. It chirps in short bursts, not as piercing as it 
could with its heavy resonating beak that crests its head, but with friendlier questing sounds. The stonecrest sparrow, like many of the birds and beasts 
of the Farplains, is migrating. The days grow shorter and the Tundrus more frigid with each passing gust of wind. The sparrows, unable to find the seeds 
that once grew plentiful among the low lying plants, moved west to the fertile Duskdown plains. Now among the warmer wind and grasses, the small 
bird felt a type of joy, an instinctual validation that they are on the right path. Chirping once again, an echoing call is heard, one tinged with curiosity 
and the unique tone of a female, in the thicket of rosewood trees past a sunlight hill, the bird rejoiced, for now, the world felt right. 
On the Farplains, the wind lives. It rushes through the tall grass, whispers to the beasts that roam to never stop, to always move, 
for under the vaulted skies of these wide plains, movement is survival. On the island of Sol’Kesh, surrounded by endless ocean and 
divided by the horizon-shattering Splitspine mountain range, far ranging herds migrate constantly, taking advantage of new blooming 
growths, favorable weather and keeping one step ahead of their pursuing predators. When confined to an island, speed is not always 
enough to escape the tusks of a draffer or burning acid of a high flying tyrandroth, and while the quick footed tartakka have adapted 
successfully enough, many others, after eons of isolation have only survived through the thickness of their shell. The mega-fauna 
that dominate the gentler east, in roaming herds thousands strong are unlike any other. The sun glimmers off the rounded shell of 
rutort, the massive beetles that dig into the fertile soil, churning the earth for roots and tubers, drafian glide across the flat fields over 
dozens of waddling bloomux, drinking deep of the flower nectar that blooms in rolling hills across Valedayn. As the dry plains of the 
Grayfynn and the Tundrus highlands do not suit the chitinous beasts, tartakka rush about, outrunning the savage grahknash and 
ambushing argustaur. While speed and durability may secure survival for most seasons, all that may change when the sky darkens with 
the cacophonous cry of hummingbirds.

The patient passerine bird clings 
onto bonestalk reeds as it waits 
for beetles to snatch with its long

An agile insect and seed eaters, this light

to the open skies of the Farplains as it

Converging on both turtle and mole-like traits, 
this toad digs within the loamy soil of the fertile 
Farplains with its fused claws. This amphibian 
can be found feasting on the grubs and larvae of 
the many arthropods of the flower fields
